newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Port Dickson Power seeks to list stock.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Port Dickson Power seeks to list stock.

text.p: Malaysian private power company Port Dickson Power Sdn Bhd has proposed to list its stock on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE), the company's shareholders said.

In a statement issued at the weekend to the KLSE, the four shareholders of Port Dickson Power said their boards had approved the listing of the power company on the KLSE's main board as an infrastructure project company.
The listing of infrastructure firms has been allowed under KLSE guidelines to help the projects raise money.

Shareholders are Sime Darby Bhd, with a 40 percent stake, Malaysian Resources Corp Bhd with 30 pct, Malakoff Bhd at 20 pct and Tenaga Nasional Bhd with 10 pct. Malakoff's ownership is through its Hypergantic Sdn Bhd unit.
Conditions for the proposed stock listing include approvals from the KLSE, the Securities Commission and other bodies, the statement said.
